deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: Log in to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to Settings > Checkout.
In the checkout settings, scroll down to the 'Additional content' section.
Click on the '+' icon to add a new script tag.
Paste the following code into the script tag: `<script src='https://example.com/returns-reason-form.js'></script>`
Replace 'https://example.com/' with your actual returns reason form URL.
In the same 'Additional content' section, click on the '+' icon to add a new block.

Select 'HTML/CSS' as the block type and paste the following code: `
`
This will render an empty container for the returns reason capture form.
Save your changes by clicking on the 'Save' button at the top right corner of the page.
To trigger the returns reason capture form, you'll need to add a new step in your Shopify return flow. Navigate to Settings > Policies > Returns.
In the 'Return flow' section, click on the '+' icon to add a new step.
Select 'Custom action' as the step type and paste the following code: `window.location.href = '/returns-reason-form';`
This will redirect customers to the returns reason capture form when they initiate a return.
Save your changes by clicking on the 'Save' button at the top right corner of the page.
The returns reason capture form should now be embedded in your Shopify returns flow.
